works.body:
On second thought, if I wanted to see it, I should have just requested it!
So, I know it seems reckless to ask you to do this in your busy schedule, but if you feel up to it, I'd like to ask you to do it.

Skull/skeleton motif (with a bone-like pattern OR like a skeleton dog, for example... this kind of direction: https://twitter.com/F11_L23/status/1684187556995547136)
 I've seen the production process, and I like the semi-tunny head base and teeth expression...

It has both "goat or sheep-like elements" and "canine-like elements" (I'll leave it up to you to decide the proportion and where and how...)
　Both can be domesticated breeds such as poodles, terriers, Suffolk sheep, etc., or wild-like characteristics such as wolves, foxes, goats, etc.
We are looking for a lonely, sweet, master-loving character....
We are open to both "Yotskemo" and "Kemono" (beast).

We are not interested in what you would like to use the image for, but would like to see it purely for our own purposes, so rough style or any kind of composition is fine.

Hi Campbell!
I'm always looking at your wonderful drawings!
I'd love to have you draw my new character in Campbell's style!

I would like to have you draw my new character!
Area of drawing] Full body or from the knees up.
Size/Resolution] More than 3000pixel on the long side.
File Format] PSD format or PNG format is preferred.
Character] Refer to the URL for reference
Clothing] Please refer to the URL for the material and leave it to us based on the clothes drawn in the material.
You can also design a new one.
Content] We'll leave it up to you!
If you have Campbell's signature, please write it on the edge of the picture!

I'm looking forward to working with you!
